purpose: Companion to GEMINI-ANTIGRAVITY.json for Gemini-origin lineages that predate the recent Antigravity Slack stream. This is a coverage and convergence lock, not runtime policy authority.

entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini Flash market work; current V4 descendants own exact crossflow, town-sale and executable-market semantics.
entries.literal_claim: Jointly optimize market-slot composition and timing around rival/public demand instead of treating each row independently.
entries.best_form: Retain only exact executable-prefix and order-budget-safe market reasoning, same-precommit-quote collision/crossflow evidence, deterministic town effects, and current cash/custody limits. Do not create a monolithic GOOP market controller.
entries.next_gate: Any policy consumer must replay on current-native routes with executable-row, cash, custody and returned-action effects proved.

entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini idle-hands/service family; current V4 idle-hands and starvation/service descendants hold implementation custody.
entries.literal_claim: When a hired hand would otherwise do nothing useful, redirect it into FEED/CARE/COLLECT or another productive service.
entries.best_form: Recycle only provably idle/dead service into a source-real productive route with actor inventory, animal/crop need, CARE output value, EOD timing and cargo custody all proved. Generic idle-action substitution is not authority.
entries.next_gate: Natural current-native engagement plus positive economics with zero service, starvation, CARE-value or custody regressions.

entries.source_lineage: Merged Gemini G01 E11 ancestry from PR #11371; unconditional runtime deferral was rejected and only the market-timing question is retained.
entries.literal_claim: Defer an existing SELL when rival dumping and the near-horizon price path make waiting better.
entries.best_form: Never defer from a coarse rival-archetype or expected-drop guess. Classify only owner replay candidates using deterministic town-drain premium, a conservative public lower bound on already-realized rival net supply, and explicit queue, custody, financing, row-budget and horizon guards. The certificate itself never mutates an action.
entries.next_gate: Census candidate/veto outcomes on current-native TOWNSELL witnesses; only the existing seller/timing owner may propose runtime consumption after both-seat economics.

entries.source_lineage: Merged Gemini G01 E20 ancestry from PR #11371; current V4 executable-prefix HIRE authority supersedes the original crude guard.
entries.literal_claim: Drop a late low-value HIRE when there is not enough remaining work for the extra hand to repay its wage.
entries.best_form: Reason only over the official executable market prefix; engine-inert suffix rows cannot consume allowance or create funding. Use exact wage/cash and the current labor/service frontier rather than a crude unserved-tile count.
entries.next_gate: Current composed postimage plus current-native two-seat economics under exact executable-prefix and funding semantics.

entries.source_lineage: Merged Gemini G01 O01 ancestry from PR #11371; static opponent labels are retired in favor of public one-way evidence.
entries.literal_claim: Classify the opponent by observed behavior and use that type to change market/capital choices.
entries.best_form: Do not classify by opponent identity or a brittle archetype. Use observable one-way certificates only: proved prior net supply, same-row collision/crossflow, deterministic town drain and current public state. No private-stock inference or post-hoc acquisition prepend is authorized.
entries.next_gate: Observable-evidence replay on current-native traces; any acquisition or sale action remains under its current funding/execution owner.

entries.source_lineage: Merged Gemini G01 shop-arbitrage ancestry from PR #11371; the fixed shop weight is superseded by exact public demand/timing models.
entries.literal_claim: Increase the attractiveness of production/sales into products with strong shop absorption.
entries.best_form: Replace the fixed absorption multiplier with exact integer shop/town transitions, unlock and replacement timing, shared RNG coupling and conservative absorption headroom. Demand evidence has no standalone decision or timing authority and excludes opponent supply unless separately proved.
entries.next_gate: A policy owner must combine current source-bound demand with real row, cash, capacity, custody and opponent-flow evidence before changing an action.

entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini Pro capital lane; current early-capital authority owns the source-safe acquisition/rebind descendants.
entries.literal_claim: Acquire useful capital/service earlier when the resulting production frontier repays the near-term cash and sequencing cost.
entries.best_form: Only current KESTREL/FLOCKBIND-style lockstep acquisition with exact executable-prefix, funding, dependent-animal rebind and custody proofs is admissible. No post-hoc prepend or unfunded acquisition assumption.
entries.next_gate: Exact current-route capital realization and paired economics under the existing early-capital owner.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini S33 / STRATUM projected-shed SELL ordering
entries.source_lineage: Historical Gemini STRATUM row-shed lane; current row-shed-sell-order package owns the implementation seam.
entries.literal_claim: Order already-authored SELL rows by projected shed relief so scarce end-of-day cargo/capacity is preserved.
entries.best_form: Projected-shed ordering is novel only if its effect survives the exact downstream canonical market-pressure transform into the final action. A pre-pressure rank difference that later collapses to the incumbent output is identity. Internal diagnostics are not a returned-action witness.
entries.next_gate: Existing row-shed owner must compare incumbent and STRATUM after the exact downstream pressure transform, bind any surviving difference to the exact action returned to the engine, then re-run current-native both-seat economics.
